notes:
Summary: Mid-market SaaS (product analytics) evaluating Redwood for company-wide semantic search + embeddings. Primary driver is to replace an ad-hoc embeddings pipeline (self-hosted open-source + occasional 3rd-party) that struggles at scale and increases maintenance overhead. They started with Hosted API to validate model quality and integration velocity; POC moved to performance validation for Dedicated (predictable throughput, lower unit costs for nightly batch jobs).

Key technical requirements: nightly batch embedding of 2M+ docs over time (current POC scaled to 500k), near-real-time semantic search for interactive UI (target p95/p99 under 150ms), vector DB flexibility (want option to use pgvector today and evaluate Milvus/managed vector service later), ability to run cross-region read replicas for EU customers (data residency question).

Model/workload preferences: prefer open/quantized models for embeddings to reduce cost, but want Redwood-verified profiles and a fallback smaller embedding model for low-cost recall. Interested in Redwood Optimize suggestions for batching/caching to reduce per-token cost for nightly runs.

Security/compliance: must hit SOC2 (already in progress), require SSO/SAML and audit logs forwarded to their SIEM. KMS integration required for customer data encryption. Legal asked about data retention controls and option for private deployment if residency requires it.

What we heard on calls: "We like the hosted API for rapid test runs — but predictability is the blocker. If Dedicated can cut unit cost by 30% on our nightly jobs and maintain 99.9% search latency SLO, procurement will greenlight."

POC notes: SE ran a 2-hour soak with simulated query mix: recall/semantic rerank + sparse retrieval pipeline. Hosted test hit ~200 qps with p99 ~120ms; bottleneck now mostly vector DB indexing/IO. Next POC stage will exercise Dedicated with larger GPU pool and end-to-end vector DB connector to validate sustained 500 qps.

Next actions assigned: 1) Redwood to deliver POC perf report (inc. cost model variants: hosted vs dedicated with commit tiers) by 2026-03-17. 2) Crestmont infra to share data residency use-cases and legal to confirm SOW changes. 3) Schedule procurement/finance sync (Maya + Crestmont procurement) week of 2026-03-20.
